verdict.rationale: Devin runs in its own workspace with a terminal ([devin-docs-6]). Its environment can be configured once so every session boots into a known-good state ([devin-docs-25]), and it can reach internal package registries and Git hosts over VPN ([devin-docs-23]). It also supports Android, macOS and Windows build machines ([devin-docs-27], [devin-docs-28], [devin-docs-32]). However, the evidence suggests the user sets up the environment once, rather than the agent autonomously cloning and bootstrapping it. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that the agent clones repos and installs dependencies on its own, evidence of the agent self-configuring its environment without user setup, and independent hands-on corroboration.
